"];
/* Appearance-only atlas renderer. No combat state, stats or abilities are modified. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const targets = [...Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>16+i),...Array.from({length:13},(_,i)=>52+i)];
  const targeted = id => targets.includes(Number(id));
  const sprites = new Map();
  const oldArt = art;
  const old16 = window.BVB1625Visual;
  const old52 = window.BVB5264Visual;
  const tierOf = value => Math.max(1,Math.min(3,Math.floor(Number(value)||1)));
  const key = (id,tier) => id+':'+tierOf(tier);
  const portrait = (id,tier=1) => sprites.get(key(id,tier))?.url ||
    (id<26 ? old16.portrait(id,tier) : old52.portrait(id,tier));
  function actor(ctx,o,g) {
    const sprite=sprites.get(key(o?.b?.id,o?.tier));
    if(!sprite) return o?.b?.id<26 ? old16.drawActor(ctx,o,g) : old52.drawActor(ctx,o,g);
    const side=o.r*2.8;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(o.x,o.y);ctx.rotate(o.rotation||0);
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
    ctx.drawImage(sprite.canvas,-side/2,-side/2,side,side);
    ctx.restore();return true;
  }
  art=function(id) {
    if(!targeted(id))return oldArt(id);
    const tier=tierOf(S?.tr?.[id]),url=portrait(id,tier);
    return `<svg data-ball-id="${id}" data-evolution="${tier}" viewBox="0 0 256 256" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="${url}" width="256" height="256" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/></svg>`;
  };
  window.BVB1625Visual={...old16,drawActor:actor,portrait};
  window.BVB5264Visual=Object.freeze({...old52,drawActor:actor,portrait});
  // Bounds exclude the headings, evolution labels and descriptions on the boards.
  const rects={};
  const x16=[[35,172],[178,311],[316,456],[493,628],[634,774],[778,914]];
  const y16=[[182,298],[495,615],[822,946],[1150,1264],[1448,1545]];
  for(let id=16;id<=25;id++)for(let v=1;v<=3;v++){
    const x=x16[(id%2)*3+v-1], y=y16[Math.floor((id-16)/2)];
    rects[key(id,v)]=[x[0],y[0],x[1]-x[0],y[1]-y[0]];
  }
  const x52=[[27,143],[145,281],[286,450],[488,608],[610,748],[750,916]];
  const y52=[[145,248],[377,484],[605,733],[843,974],[1103,1221],[1340,1456]];
  for(let id=52;id<=63;id++)for(let v=1;v<=3;v++){
    const x=x52[(id%2)*3+v-1],y=y52[Math.floor((id-52)/2)];
    rects[key(id,v)]=[x[0],y[0],x[1]-x[0],y[1]-y[0]];
  }
  for(let v=1;v<=3;v++){const x=[[27,142],[145,282],[285,441]][v-1];rects[key(64,v)]=[x[0],1570,x[1]-x[0],85];}
  // Each evolution has its own silhouette height; one shared row crop clips V3.
  const bounds52={
    52:[[35,160,139,246],[145,145,281,247],[283,128,453,247]],
    53:[[487,157,607,247],[605,137,748,247],[748,124,914,247]],
    54:[[25,393,144,482],[146,380,283,484],[284,361,453,486]],
    55:[[486,393,607,483],[604,374,749,485],[747,355,913,486]],
    56:[[26,637,145,731],[145,606,284,732],[283,598,454,733]],
    57:[[487,635,609,731],[606,615,749,733],[746,599,914,734]],
    58:[[27,876,145,971],[145,855,284,973],[283,841,454,974]],
    59:[[487,886,609,973],[606,869,749,974],[746,850,914,974]],
    60:[[26,1137,145,1221],[144,1123,284,1221],[282,1099,454,1221]],
    61:[[487,1139,609,1220],[605,1122,749,1221],[746,1104,914,1221]],
    62:[[26,1376,145,1455],[144,1361,284,1456],[282,1334,454,1457]],
    63:[[487,1376,609,1455],[605,1358,749,1456],[746,1329,923,1457]],
    64:[[26,1587,145,1655],[144,1576,284,1655],[282,1556,443,1655]]
  };
  for(const [id,versions] of Object.entries(bounds52))versions.forEach(([x,y,right,bottom],i)=>{rects[key(id,i+1)]=[x,y,right-x,bottom-y];});
  function frame(atlas,rect) {
    const [x,y,w,h]=rect;
    const cut=document.createElement('canvas');cut.width=w;cut.height=h;
    const c=cut.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});c.drawImage(atlas,x,y,w,h,0,0,w,h);
    const data=c.getImageData(0,0,w,h),p=data.data;
    // Only edge-connected navy background is keyed; dark enclosed armour stays opaque.
    const visited=new Uint8Array(w*h),queue=new Int32Array(w*h);let head=0,tail=0;
    const background=i=>{const at=i*4,r=p[at],g=p[at+1],b=p[at+2];return r<31&&g<51&&b<78;};
    function push(i){if(!visited[i]&&background(i)){visited[i]=1;queue[tail++]=i;}}
    for(let xx=0;xx<w;xx++){push(xx);push((h-1)*w+xx);}
    for(let yy=0;yy<h;yy++){push(yy*w);push(yy*w+w-1);}
    while(head<tail){const i=queue[head++],xx=i%w,yy=Math.floor(i/w);if(xx)push(i-1);if(xx<w-1)push(i+1);if(yy)push(i-w);if(yy<h-1)push(i+w);}
    for(let i=0;i<visited.length;i++)if(visited[i])p[i*4+3]=0;
    // Discard disconnected lettering and panel borders from the atlas, while
    // retaining coloured particles/cards around the main silhouette.
    const seen=new Uint8Array(w*h),components=[];
    for(let start=0;start<w*h;start++){
      if(seen[start]||!p[start*4+3])continue;
      const cells=[start];seen[start]=1;let loX=w,hiX=0,loY=h,hiY=0,saturation=0;
      for(let at=0;at<cells.length;at++){
        const i=cells[at],xx=i%w,yy=Math.floor(i/w),q=i*4;
        loX=Math.min(loX,xx);hiX=Math.max(hiX,xx);loY=Math.min(loY,yy);hiY=Math.max(hiY,yy);
        saturation+=(Math.max(p[q],p[q+1],p[q+2])-Math.min(p[q],p[q+1],p[q+2]))/Math.max(1,p[q],p[q+1],p[q+2]);
        const next=[];if(xx)next.push(i-1);if(xx<w-1)next.push(i+1);if(yy)next.push(i-w);if(yy<h-1)next.push(i+w);
        for(const j of next)if(!seen[j]&&p[j*4+3]){seen[j]=1;cells.push(j);}
      }
      components.push({cells,loX,hiX,loY,hiY,saturation:saturation/cells.length});
    }
    const primary=components.reduce((a,b)=>!a||b.cells.length>a.cells.length?b:a,null);
    for(const part of components){
      if(part===primary)continue;
      const cw=part.hiX-part.loX+1,ch=part.hiY-part.loY+1;
      const distance=Math.hypot((part.loX+part.hiX)/2-w/2,(part.loY+part.hiY)/2-h/2);
      const keep=part.cells.length>=25&&part.saturation>.48&&cw/ch<4&&ch/cw<6&&distance<Math.max(w,h)*.52;
      if(!keep)for(const i of part.cells)p[i*4+3]=0;
    }
    // A one-pixel alpha transition avoids rectangular blue fringes when scaled down.
    for(let yy=1;yy<h-1;yy++)for(let xx=1;xx<w-1;xx++){
      const i=yy*w+xx;if(visited[i]||!p[i*4+3])continue;
      if(visited[i-1]||visited[i+1]||visited[i-w]||visited[i+w]){
        const at=i*4,m=Math.max(p[at],p[at+1],p[at+2]);p[at+3]=Math.min(255,Math.max(60,(m-20)*3));
      }
    }
    c.putImageData(data,0,0);
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=256;
    const out=canvas.getContext('2d'),scale=236/Math.max(w,h),dw=w*scale,dh=h*scale;
    out.drawImage(cut,(256-dw)/2,(256-dh)/2,dw,dh);
    return {canvas,url:canvas.toDataURL('image/png'),rect};
  }
  function load(src){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>resolve(im);im.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Nie można wczytać planszy wzorcowej'));im.src=src;});}
  const ready=Promise.all([load(BVB_APPEARANCE_ATLASES[0]),load(BVB_APPEARANCE_ATLASES[1])]).then(([a16,a52])=>{
    const replacements=new Map();
    for(const id of targets)for(let v=1;v<=3;v++){
      const k=key(id,v),s=frame(id<26?a16:a52,rects[k]);sprites.set(k,s);
      // Update existing preview/detail closures to use the same artwork as combat.
      const im=id<26?old16.assets[k]:old52.pictures.get(k);
      if(im){replacements.set(im.src,s.url);im.src=s.url;}
    }
    for(const id of targets){ART.delete(id);const im=new Image();im.src=portrait(id,tierOf(S?.tr?.[id]));ART_IMAGES.set(id,im);}
    for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('svg[data-ball-id]'))if(targeted(el.dataset.ballId)){
      el.querySelector('image')?.setAttribute('href',portrait(+el.dataset.ballId,+el.dataset.evolution));
    }
    for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('svg image')){const next=replacements.get(el.getAttribute('href'));if(next)el.setAttribute('href',next);}
    for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('img')){const next=replacements.get(el.src);if(next)el.src=next;}
    document.documentElement.dataset.bvbAppearance='ready';
    return {count:sprites.size,ids:targets.slice()};
  }).catch(error=>{console.error('BVB appearance',error);document.documentElement.dataset.bvbAppearance='error';throw error;});
  window.BVBAppearance=Object.freeze({ready,portrait,sprites,rects,ids:targets.slice(),version:'reference-atlas-1'});
})();
</script>
